# TapePhoto

> TapePhoto (tapephoto.com) is the photography site of Carlos Martinez, a photographer based in Coquimbo, Chile. The portfolio covers motorsport, concerts, aerial drone, street and travel photography; the services pages cover photography for businesses, hotels and tourism, and real estate in La Serena, Coquimbo and the Coquimbo Region. The home page, the local-business pages and the blog are in Spanish (the home page also has an English version at /en/); the portfolio and licensing pages also exist in English.

## About
- Author: Carlos Martinez, photographer (Coquimbo, Chile). Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/tapephotocom/
- Contact: carlos@netwebmedia.com · WhatsApp +1 (442) 385-4585 (https://wa.me/14423854585?text=Hi%2C%20I%20found%20tapephoto.com%20and%20want%20a%20quote%20for%20a%20photo%20shoot)
- Quotes: every session is quoted per project; request one through the contact form (https://tapephoto.com/contact.html) or WhatsApp. No prices are published on the site.
- 136 Spanish-language blog articles published so far.

## Main pages
- [Inicio (Español)](https://tapephoto.com/): home page in Spanish, selected work, local business photography overview, FAQ
- [Home (English)](https://tapephoto.com/en/): the same home page in English
- [Services (English)](https://tapephoto.com/services.html): four services (aerial and drone, real estate, motorsport and events, business and brand) with FAQ and quote request
- [Servicios (Español)](https://tapephoto.com/servicios.html): the same services in Spanish
- [Fotografía inmobiliaria en La Serena y Coquimbo](https://tapephoto.com/fotografia-inmobiliaria-la-serena.html): interiors, exteriors and drone in one visit, for brokers and real estate firms
- [Fotografía para hoteles y cabañas en La Serena](https://tapephoto.com/fotografia-hoteles-turismo-la-serena.html): rooms, common areas and aerials, ready for Booking and social media
- [Fotos y reel para Airbnb en La Serena](https://tapephoto.com/fotos-airbnb-la-serena.html): "Pack Listing" for short-term rental hosts and managers, edited listing photos plus a vertical reel in one visit
- [Checklist para anfitriones: arriendo listo antes de febrero](https://tapephoto.com/checklist-airbnb-antes-de-febrero.html): month-by-month plan and room-by-room list for short-term rental hosts before the February peak
- [Fotografía para empresas en La Serena y Coquimbo](https://tapephoto.com/fotografia-empresas-la-serena.html): team, premises and product photography instead of stock images
- [Galleries](https://tapephoto.com/galleries/): 18 curated photo galleries in seven categories — Motorsport (WRC Rally Chile 2019, rally raid in the Atacama, Grand Prix of Long Beach 2018, ISDE enduro, MTB enduro), Events (Del Mar Opening Day, Hermosa Beach St. Patrick's parade, Lebowski Fest, poker tour, live music), Portraits, Street & Cities (Playas de Tijuana, San Francisco & Los Angeles, Las Vegas nights), Architecture & Cities (San Diego waterfront and downtown), Aerial & Drone, Landscapes & Travel (Andes & glaciers; coast, travel & wildlife)
- [Licensing (English)](https://tapephoto.com/licensing.html): license photographs from the archive (editorial online and print, books and broadcast, advertising, local-business use); written quote within 24 hours via an inquiry form (usage, media, duration, territory, deadline) or WhatsApp
- [Licencias (Español)](https://tapephoto.com/licencias.html): the same licensing page in Spanish, with the inquiry form
- [Prints (English)](https://tapephoto.com/prints.html): request a print of landscape and coast photographs from the galleries (Andes, glaciers, sunsets, Easter Island moai, sea); no price list, every print is quoted via the contact form or WhatsApp
- [Impresiones (Español)](https://tapephoto.com/impresiones.html): the same prints page in Spanish
- [About](https://tapephoto.com/about.html) · [Contact](https://tapephoto.com/contact.html) · [Contacto](https://tapephoto.com/contacto.html)
- [Blog (Spanish)](https://tapephoto.com/blog/): practical guides for businesses, hotels and real estate brokers

- [Celular vs fotógrafo profesional: qué esperar al contratar](https://tapephoto.com/blog/celular-vs-fotografo-que-esperar.html) [Técnica]: Diferencias reales entre fotos con celular y sesión profesional. Cómo funciona el proceso: agenda, duración y entrega de archivos.
